english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a cut of pork containing the rib bones.

exampleSentences.english: This sparerib is perfect for making soup.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 gin6 paai4 gwat1 ngaam1 saai3 bou1 tong1

english.note: Use 排骨 for rib meat, especially as a food or dish, rather than for the bone in the body.

exampleSentences.english: The rib dish here is so good that I want to order another plate。
